scores.rationale: The candidate implementation was cut short mid-flight and leaves the codebase broken. While `ToolRegistry.register` was updated to compile static schemas with `ajv`, `ajv` was never added to `package.json`, and `ToolRegistry.execute` was not updated at all to actually run the validator. Furthermore, `dynamicValidators` is declared as an unused private field on `ToolRegistry` (which fails TypeScript/ESLint checks), and three of the four tests added in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` fail immediately because `execute` does not validate input. Almost all required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, along with updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `CHANGELOG.md`, are completely missing.
